🇦🇷🌾 Rotary Friendship Exchange – A Memorable Farmhouse Experience in Argentina

Culture • Countryside • Camaraderie

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE Argentina 2026–27 | District 4895

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange, the delegation from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, enjoyed a wonderful farmhouse visit hosted by our warm-hearted Rotary friends from District 4895, Argentina.

The visit began with a gracious welcome to the Indian delegation, making everyone feel at home and setting the tone for a delightful day of cultural discovery, learning and fellowship.

The farmhouse experience offered a beautiful glimpse into Argentine rural life and local traditions. The highlight was a vibrant presentation of traditional Argentine dance, showcasing the country's rich cultural heritage. The delegates also enjoyed a charming horse-cart ride and a farmhouse tour, learning about the various activities carried out on the property and gaining a deeper appreciation of the local way of life.

Adding to the experience was a delicious spread of locally prepared food, offering an authentic taste of Argentina and its culinary traditions.

More than just a visit, it was an opportunity to connect with our hosts, exchange experiences, discover a different culture and create memories that will remain with us long after the journey ends.

Our heartfelt thanks to our Argentine Rotary hosts for their exceptional hospitality and for making this countryside experience so special.

❤️ From Indian Friendships to Argentine Traditions—One Rotary Family!

Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27
District 3141, India 🤝 District 4895, Argentina

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
